about: What each CLI does with an attachment's path (#387), checked on 12 Oct 2026 in test homes only. A kind is 'native' when the CLI's own file tool returns it as what it is; every other kind goes as a path the agent opens with its tools. The probe: a folder with report.pdf (one page, the word PELICAN, uncompressed), shot.png (1x1) and notes.log, and a prompt asking the agent to read each.

claude-code.how: claude -p in the signed-in test home (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=%LOCALAPPDATA%\hive-test\claude), Haiku, --allowedTools Read, stream-json

evidence.pdf: Read's tool_result: [{type: 'text', text: 'PDF file read: …report.pdf (581 bytes)'}, {type: 'document', source: {type: 'base64', media_type: 'application/pdf'}}]; the reply: PELICAN
evidence.image: a pasted image path becomes [Image #n]; Read returns an image block

codex.how: codex exec in the signed-in test home (CODEX_HOME=%LOCALAPPDATA%\hive-test\codex), --sandbox read-only, --json

evidence.pdf: no file tool for PDFs: it ran PowerShell Get-Content -Raw report.pdf and read the raw bytes (readable only because the probe's PDF is uncompressed)
evidence.image: a pasted image path becomes [Image #n] (src/shared/codex.ts); it also has view_image

copilot.how: copilot -p offline (COPILOT_OFFLINE=true, a stand-in model API, a test COPILOT_HOME, gh hidden), the stand-in calling its view tool on each file

evidence.view tool: View files, images, or directories. * Images return base64 data and MIME type. * Text files return their content.
evidence.pdf: view's result was the PDF's raw bytes as text (%PDF-1.4 …)
evidence.image: view's result: 'Viewed image file successfully.', the image sent to the model
